in_marathi.name: Malkeet
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon God's Power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Malkeet हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Malkeet is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Mal' meaning moon and 'Ketu' meaning power or shadow. In Hindu mythology, Ketu is a planet that represents spiritual growth and transformation. The name Malkeet signifies the power of the moon god, which brings wisdom, intuition, and protection.
